address: Supanniga Home, 130/9 Phothisan Road, Phra Lap, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: Named after the Supanniga flower, this cute shop offers delightful dishes blending flavours from the eastern seaboard and Isan cuisine. Grandma's recipes inspire the food here. Don't miss the must-order chamuang pork—a juicy stewed pork infused with Chamuang leaf's slightly sour flavour. The restaurant provides indoor and outdoor seating, including shaded tables in the tree house....
